descriptions.zh-Hans: 在北京尝过薄饼包烤鸭后写的菜单。菜名旁边还留着我先写下的“再来一口”。
descriptions.en: My card after trying Peking duck in a pancake in Beijing. “Another bite” still sits beside the dish’s name.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我吃过北京炸酱面后留下的菜单，下面写着自己的小顺序：先拌面，再写信。
descriptions.en: A card from my bowl of Beijing zhajiang noodles, with a personal reminder: noodles first, letter second.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在北京故宫等一位旅人时记下的小声音。邮包拉链也在里面占了一行。
descriptions.en: Sounds from waiting for a traveler at Beijing’s Forbidden City. My mailbag zipper earned a line of its own.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在北京写炸酱面菜单时，我差点把吃饭和写信的顺序弄混。这是重新写清楚的一张。
descriptions.en: My corrected instructions from a zhajiang-noodle lunch in Beijing, after the pencil and the noodles nearly exchanged jobs.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在颐和园记山、水和亭台时留下的长停顿。中间只有一个陪我歇脚的小逗号。
descriptions.en: A pause between my words for the Summer Palace’s hills, water and pavilions, occupied by one resting comma.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在北京，我和一位旅人给自己的两张小菜单各排了一次朗读顺序。留着换着读。
descriptions.en: A traveler and I each arranged a reading order for my two Beijing menu cards. Both versions came along.
